scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof and reproducible symbolic-numeric checks accompany the finding. The earliest public source date is the arXiv submission history date, September 2, 2026. Numerical decimals are illustrative; independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Proves optimizer classification only for jump sizes 1 and 5 and mixture probabilities q in [q_-,1], with q_- explicitly specified. Makes no minimality claim for q_- and no claim for q<q_- or other jump sizes. Exact proofs, not finite tests, support universal conclusions. Unindexed earlier overlap is possible.
title: A sharp local-to-interior transition for two-point compound-Poisson sub-gamma scales
